([[Hinesville, Georgia]]) | college = * [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]] (2017–2018) * [[Baylor Bears basketball|Baylor]] (2019–2021) | highlights = * [[List of NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Champions|NCAA champion]] ([[2021 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament|2021]]) * [[Naismith Defensive Player of the Year Award|Naismith Defensive Player of the Year]] (2021) * [[NABC Defensive Player of the Year]] (2021) * [[Lefty Driesell Award]] (2021) * Third-team [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] – [[Associated Press|AP]], [[National Association of Basketball Coaches|NABC]], ''[[Sporting News|SN]]'' ([[2021 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2021]]) * First-team All-[[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] (2021) * Third-team All-Big 12 (2020) * Big 12 Defensive Player of the Year (2021) * 2× Big 12 All-Defensive Team (2020, 2021) * Big 12 Newcomer of the Year (2020) * Big 12 All-Newcomer Team (2020) }} '''Davion Mitchell''' (born September 5, 1998) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn Tigers]] and the [[Baylor Bears basketball|Baylor Bears]]. ==High school career== Mitchell attended [[Liberty County High School (Georgia)|Liberty County High School]] in [[Hinesville, Georgia]]. As a junior, he averaged 24.2 points, 7.1 assists and 2.9 steals per game, leading his team to its first Class 4A state title. Mitchell was named ''[[Savannah Morning News]]'' Player of the Year.{{cite web |last1=Knight |first1=Dennis |title=Boys Basketball Player of the Year: Davion Mitchell, Liberty County |url=https://www.savannahnow.com/article/20160528/SPORTS/305289837 |website=[[Savannah Morning News]] |accessdate=October 28, 2020 |date=May 28, 2016}} In his senior season, he averaged 23.8 points, 5.3 rebounds and 5.2 assists per game. Mitchell competed for the Georgia Stars on the [[Amateur Athletic Union]] circuit.{{cite web |last1=Werner |first1=John |title=Davion Mitchell brings tenacity to Baylor D |url=https://wacotrib.com/sports/college/baylor/davion-mitchell-brings-tenacity-to-baylor-d/article_834d3201-81e0-55bd-95ec-263af0b7e38c.html |website=[[Waco Tribune-Herald]] |accessdate=October 9, 2020 |date=February 14, 2020}} A consensus four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]], he committed to playing college basketball for [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]] over offers from [[Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball|Cincinnati]], [[UConn Huskies men's basketball|UConn]], [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida]], [[Georgia Bulldogs basketball|Georgia]] and [[Clemson Tigers men's basketball|Clemson]], among others.{{cite web |last1=Kramer |first1=Daniel |title=Davion Mitchell to Auburn: Tigers Land 4-Star PG Prospect |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2579576-davion-mitchell-to-auburn-tigers-land-4-star-pg-prospect |website=[[Bleacher Report]] |accessdate=October 28, 2020 |date=October 15, 2015}} ==College career== As a freshman at Auburn, Mitchell averaged 3.7 points and 1.9 assists per game as a backup [[point guard]] to [[Jared Harper]].{{cite web |last1=Stevens |first1=Matthew |title=Davion Mitchell to transfer away from Auburn after one season |url=https://www.montgomeryadvertiser.com/story/sports/college/auburn/2018/03/29/davion-mitchell-transfer-away-auburn-after-one-season/471330002/ |website=[[Montgomery Advertiser]] |accessdate=October 9, 2020 |date=March 29, 2018}} Following the season, he transferred to [[Baylor Bears basketball|Baylor]] and sat out his next season due to [[National Collegiate Athletic Association]] transfer rules.{{cite web |last1=Berger |first1=Matthew |title=Baylor basketball adds transfer Davion Mitchell |url=https://www.dallasnews.com/sports/2018/04/16/baylor-basketball-adds-transfer-davion-mitchell/ |website=[[The Dallas Morning News]] |date=April 15, 2018}} During his [[redshirt (college sports)|redshirt]] year, he improved his all-around game and studied film on guards like [[Kyle Lowry]] and [[Jalen Brunson]]. During his sophomore season, Mitchell was a starter on one of the top teams in the nation.{{cite web |last1=Moore |first1=CJ |title=Jared Butler and Davion Mitchell are driving one another to greatness at Baylor |url=https://theathletic.com/1651984/2020/03/05/jared-butler-and-davion-mitchell-are-driving-one-another-to-greatness-at-baylor/ |website=[[The Athletic]] |accessdate=October 9, 2020 |date=March 5, 2020}} On December 18, 2019, he posted a season-high 19 points, four assists and four steals in a 91–63 win over [[UT Martin Skyhawks men's basketball|UT Martin]].{{cite web |last1=Werner |first1=John |title=Mitchell guides Baylor men to 91-63 romp over Skyhawks in Houston |url=https://wacotrib.com/sports/college/baylor/mitchell-guides-baylor-men-to-91-63-romp-over-skyhawks-in-houston/article_371b6894-b9cb-558e-99ad-8dc09fe33e6a.html |website=[[Waco Tribune-Herald]] |accessdate=October 9, 2020 |date=December 18, 2019}} As a sophomore, Mitchell averaged 9.9 points and 3.8 assists per game. He was named [[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] Newcomer of the Year, while earning Third Team All-Big 12, All-Defensive and All-Newcomer Team honors.{{cite web |last1=Mastandrea |first1=Matthew |title=Baylor Basketball: Davion Mitchell poised for career year with Bears in 2020-21 |url=https://bustingbrackets.com/2020/09/18/baylor-basketball-davion-mitchell-poised-career-year-bears-2020-21/ |website=Busting Brackets |accessdate=October 9, 2020 |date=September 18, 2020}} In his junior season, Mitchell became an improved shooter and passer.{{cite web |last1=Ham |first1=James |title=How NBA draft prospect Mitchell fits both Warriors and Kings |url=https://www.nbcsports.com/bayarea/kings/2021-nba-draft-how-baylors-davion-mitchell-fits-warriors-kings |website=[[NBC Sports]] |access-date=July 21, 2021 |date=July 14, 2021}} He scored a career-high 31 points and seven three-pointers in a 107–59 win over [[Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball|Kansas State]] on January 27, 2021.{{cite web |last1=Chamblee |first1=Will |title=Davion Mitchell is red hot for Baylor on both sides of the court |url=https://baylorlariat.com/2021/02/17/davion-mitchell-is-red-hot-for-baylor-on-both-sides-of-the-court/ |website=[[The Baylor Lariat]] |access-date=July 21, 2021 |date=February 17, 2021}} Mitchell helped Baylor win its first national championship, recording 15 points, six rebounds and five assists in a 86–70 win against previously undefeated [[Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball|Gonzaga]] in the [[2021 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship Game|title game]].{{cite web |last1=Dominitz |first1=Nathan |title=The stuff of legends: Savannah-area star Mitchell leads Baylor to national championship |url=https://www.savannahnow.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2021/04/06/baylor-basketball-national-champion-guard-davion-mitchell-of-hinesville-beats-gonzaga-for-ncaa-title/7104206002/ |website=[[Savannah Morning News]] |access-date=July 21, 2021 |date=April 6, 2021}} He received the [[Naismith Defensive Player of the Year Award]], [[NABC Defensive Player of the Year]] and the [[Lefty Driesell Award]] as the top defensive player in the nation.{{cite web |last1=Aleman |first1=Christian |last2=Houmard |first2=Celeste |title=Baylor's Davion Mitchell scores Lefty Driesell, NABC, Naismith defensive player of the year awards |url=https://www.kcentv.com/article/sports/baylors-mitchell-awarded-2021-lefty-driesell-national-defensive-player-of-the-year/500-61143bff-06a2-4e0c-8e22-288f90810c56 |website=[[KCEN-TV]] |access-date=July 21, 2021 |date=April 1, 2021}} Mitchell earned Big 12 Defensive Player of the Year and First Team All-Big 12 honors.{{cite web |last1=Sulkowski |first1=Frank |title=Liberty County's Davion Mitchell named Big 12 Defensive Player of the Year |url=https://www.wjcl.com/article/liberty-countys-davion-mitchell-named-big-12-defensive-player-of-the-year/35774783# |website=[[WJCL (TV)|WJCL]] |access-date=July 21, 2021 |date=March 8, 2021}} On April 13, he declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]], forgoing his remaining college eligibility.{{cite web |last1=Boone |first1=Kyle|title=Baylor star Davion Mitchell declares after helping lead Bears to first national championship |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/2021-nba-draft-baylor-star-davion-mitchell-declares-after-helping-lead-bears-to-first-national-championship/|website=[[CBSSports.com]]
